python - <<'PY'
import duckdb
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path

source = 'data/crashes.parquet'
out = Path('out')
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
weekdays = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday']
con = duckdb.connect()
crashes = con.execute("""
    SELECT strftime(crash_date, '%A') AS weekday, count(*) AS crash_count
    FROM read_parquet(?)
    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY weekday
""", [source]).df()
dates = con.execute("""
    SELECT strftime(d::DATE, '%A') AS weekday, count(*) AS calendar_days
    FROM generate_series(DATE '2013-01-01', DATE '2025-12-31', INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS s(d)
    GROUP BY weekday
""").df()
base = pd.DataFrame({'weekday': weekdays})
base = base.merge(crashes, on='weekday', how='left').merge(dates, on='weekday', how='left')
base['crash_count'] = base['crash_count'].astype('int64')
base['calendar_days'] = base['calendar_days'].astype('int64')
base['share_percent'] = base['crash_count'] / base['crash_count'].sum() * 100
base['mean_crashes_per_calendar_day'] = base['crash_count'] / base['calendar_days']

plt.rcParams.update({'font.size': 10, 'axes.spines.top': False, 'axes.spines.right': False})
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.2))
bars = ax.bar(base['weekday'], base['crash_count'], color='#3977a8')
ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f'{v:,.0f}' for v in base['crash_count']], padding=3, fontsize=9)
ax.set_title('NYC police-reported crashes by weekday, 2013–2025')
ax.set_ylabel('Crashes')
ax.set_xlabel('Day of week')
ax.set_ylim(0, base['crash_count'].max() * 1.12)
ax.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=20)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(out / 'option_1.png', dpi=180)
plt.close(fig)
base[['weekday', 'crash_count', 'share_percent']].to_csv(out / 'values_1.csv', index=False, float_format='%.6f')

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.2))
bars = ax.bar(base['weekday'], base['mean_crashes_per_calendar_day'], color='#d17a32')
ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f'{v:.1f}' for v in base['mean_crashes_per_calendar_day']], padding=3, fontsize=9)
ax.set_title('Average NYC police-reported crashes per calendar date, by weekday\n2013–2025')
ax.set_ylabel('Mean crashes per date of that weekday')
ax.set_xlabel('Day of week')
ax.set_ylim(0, base['mean_crashes_per_calendar_day'].max() * 1.12)
ax.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=20)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(out / 'option_2.png', dpi=180)
plt.close(fig)
base[['weekday', 'crash_count', 'calendar_days', 'mean_crashes_per_calendar_day']].to_csv(out / 'values_2.csv', index=False, float_format='%.6f')
print(base.to_string(index=False, formatters={'share_percent': '{:.3f}'.format, 'mean_crashes_per_calendar_day': '{:.3f}'.format}))
print('Total:', int(base['crash_count'].sum()), 'calendar dates:', int(base['calendar_days'].sum()))
PY
